replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Honestly, I find it a bit dry and disconnected from my passions like literature and art. While I appreciate its logic, I often feel overwhelmed by abstract concepts that don't seem to have real-world applications in my daily life or creative hobbies.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. The pressure to understand complex formulas can trigger my moderate neuroticism. I worry about making mistakes or not grasping the material quickly enough, which makes me avoid math-heavy tasks whenever possible.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI tutor recently, but it felt too rigid and impersonal. It didn't connect with my interests or explain things in a way that resonated with me. I prefer more creative, human-led approaches to learning.
